patthana23.54:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.54:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.54:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nauppannattike sanidassanattika uppannattikaṃ
